articleTitle: Why You Can't Eat Around Your Partner Without Feeling Sick
imageHeadline: Nausea when eating with your partner isn't the ick
imageSubtext: It's a documented social anxiety response—and it's treatable
pinTitle: Why Eating in Front of Your Partner Triggers Nausea (Social Anxiety & Relationships)
pinDescription: If you feel sick every time you eat with your new partner—even though the relationship is good—it may be social anxiety, not a relationship problem. Learn why eating while being observed triggers physical symptoms and what gradual exposure and CBT can do to help.

items.label: Recognize it's anxiety, not the relationship
Start with low-stakes foods or snacks
Talk to a therapist if it persists
